test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In what time will ₹10,000 at 4% per annum, produce the same interest as ₹8,000 does in 4 years at 5% simple interest?
solution:
Given 

A person invests on simple interest = Rs. 10000

A person invests on simple interest = Rs. 8,000

Rate of Interest = 4%

Rate of Interest = 5%

Time = t year

Time = 4 year

Formula used.

Simple interest = Principal × Time × Rate/100

Amount = Principal(1 - Rate/100)2

Calculation 

The Rate of Interest for the first and second sum is 4% and 5% p.a. respectively.

(10000 × 4 × t) / 100 = ((8000) × 4 × 5) / 100

⇒ 40t = 160

⇒ t = 160/40

⇒ t = 4

The value of t (in percentage) is 4 years.
